body.subject: An unjudged check run names its cause, and the unjudged branch gets its first native case

items.change: The gate's unjudged verdict was a fixed sentence, so the operator could not see what made the run unjudged. It now names the first output line that is not a failure identity, and says the check printed nothing when it printed nothing - the shape the other unjudged verdicts already carry.
items.evidence: observed in the first landing attempt of the retained live worker: blocked with '?unjudged candidate: bend2/test/coordinator.py: check output is not failure identities' while the check had printed 'sh: cannot open the check'; the verdict now carries that line

items.change: Case M of the native land test covers the unjudged branch for the first time: a check that prints one non-identity line leaves the run unjudged, which blocks the landing, the target does not advance, and the block names the line. The case is red with the old verdict.
items.evidence: green at this tip: 'land checks: all green' (A-M); with unjudged_why reverted, the same binary reports 'FAILURES: land M: the block does not name its cause: new failures: ?unjudged candidate: nid.txt: check output is not failure identities'

items.change: The same branch carries aa757581, the live-worker record correction reported in contribution-7230ce94277047add430ce40a42f60ea, so one landing of this tip delivers both.

environmentRed: The deployment verification command (npm test --prefix impl, the canonical whole suite) was not run by this seat: the root's standing instruction forbids a whole or near-whole suite outside swarm integrate, and this change is bend2 only. bend2/test/land.py (10 rows, including the two push rows) is green, with the lane's two native programs: land checks A-M all green, git-lane checks all green.

carriedForward: Landing either contribution of this branch converges, but the tip 6073b9bd is the single commit that carries both; the older one alone delivers only the docs correction.
The unjudged verdict now embeds the offending line whole and unterminated by any cap; a line the run printed is a line the operator sees.

needsFromOthers.ask: land commit 6073b9bda0673757cfc4c6415cd7b4bdb006456d (branch baton/bend2-git5, on top of b6594f5f; it carries aa757581 too) onto bend2-rewrite with swarm integrate; this seat's swarm.integrate refused swarm_permission_required (organize).
